title_zh: 核对不同班次的问卷配额

scenario.label_zh: 改进不同班次的问卷配额和需求排序说明
scenario.goal_zh: 发现夜班答卷不足并约定补充收集后分别呈现需求排序

context_zh: 研究方法练习中，Morgan 与 Jia 使用虚构的员工休息区需求问卷，不用于评价或筛选员工。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: Our quota for the break-area survey was ten responses from each shift, but we have only three from the night team.

sentences.speaker: Jia
sentences.text: Then this ranking of improvements mostly reflects the other two shifts.

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: Should we send one more invitation to the night team?

sentences.speaker: Jia
sentences.text: Yes, without pressuring anyone. After that, show each shift's ranking and the number of responses.

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: I'll revise the invitation and split the results by shift, with those counts beside each ranking.

targets.sense_zh: 按顺序排列的名次或排序
